mapper.sql: sch15_ipo_item_matching_id AS ipo_item_matching_id, sch15_item_cd AS item_code, sch15_valid_item_cd AS valid_item_code, sch15_item_nm AS item_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sch15_ipo_item_matching WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sch15_item_cd, sch15_valid_item_cd, sch15_item_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY sch15_item_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch15_ipo_item_matching (sch15_ipo_item_matching_id, sch15_item_cd, sch15_valid_item_cd, sch15_item_nm) VALUES (#{id}, #{req.itemCode}, #{req.validItemCode}, #{req.itemName})
